image_prompt.text: An oversized central plaza floored in large concrete tiles laid in geometric patterns, open enough to hold a dense crowd of avatars without traffic jams
Curving paved walkways threading through the park and feeding the plaza, sized for foot traffic, with classic black street lamp posts lining them
An octagonal covered pavilion with a red tile roof on white columns standing at the centre of the plaza, tall enough to navigate by from anywhere in the park
A circular stone water feature ringed by dark wooden benches under the palms, detailed as a scenic backdrop for screenshots and roleplay scenes
Tall palm trees and leafy shade trees scattered throughout the park
Dark wooden park benches set along the curving paved walkways
Low concrete planters filled with green bushes edging the plaza and paths
Realistic tropical materials throughout — weathered concrete, red clay roof tile, stone, dark stained wood

notes: Prompt self-declares 'for a Roblox roleplay game', so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads even though the body of the prompt is a pure environment description; no second genre was doing real work, so nothing else was loaded.

Shape is Static Settlement: the prompt describes a fixed public park plaza with no houses, plots, or personal property of any kind, so none of the claimable/buildable housing models apply. That also keeps this off the genre's usual P3 default.

No building-interior taken. The pavilion is an open-sided roof on columns, not an enterable room, and nothing in the prompt sends a player indoors — so the genre note that 'this genre is P3 by default in practice' does not bite here and the route stays entirely on P0.

The circular water feature is carried as vignette-photo (whose own definition names fountains) rather than the universal water-body option — it is a decorative plaza centrepiece, not a swum or barrier body of water, and filing it as water-body would have added a CHECK the prompt does not earn.
path-road-vehicle deliberately not taken: this is a walking-only park, and the genre note warns against demanding 15/30-stud vehicle streets of every game in the genre.
layout_placement is empty because every pick here is image-side geometry; no triggers, spawns, or invisible volumes were requested.

would have asked: 'Sounds like a static roleplay town space — a fixed, pre-built plaza with no player property, built as an oversized gathering square with a landmark pavilion at its centre and detailed photo spots around the fountain. I'd add pedestrian walkways for the curving paths you described. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?'

would have asked: 'Do players go inside the pavilion or any surrounding shops? Right now I'm treating the pavilion as an open-sided shelter, which keeps this a single-pass build; enterable interiors would need to be generated separately and is a slower build.'
would have asked: 'Is this park a standalone hangout, or one district of a larger roleplay town? If it is part of a town I'd want to know whether roads and vehicles are in play.'
would have asked: 'Anything else you want in the space?'
